b1-unit-04.04.1 Ana calls Danny: a favor at the air:
Danny: Hello?
Ana: Hi Danny! It's Ana. Listen, I need a big favor. My cousin Carol is flying in from Orlando tomorrow morning, and I can't pick her up at the airport. I have to work a twelve-hour shift at the hospital. Could you meet her at Guarulhos and bring her to my place? I'll pay for the taxi, of course.
Danny: Sure, no problem! But I've never met her. What does she look like?
Ana: OK, let me think. She's in her early forties, and she's fairly tall... about my height. She's slim, but quite well-built, because she goes to the gym every day. She's got an oval face and big brown eyes.
Danny: And her hair?
Ana: Well, that's the tricky part. She used to have long, straight dark hair, like me. But last month she sent me a photo, and she's dyed it red! And now it's shoulder-length and curly. So look for the red curls.
Danny: Red curls. Got it. Anything else?
Ana: She's quite tanned, because she lives in Florida and she spends every weekend at the beach. Oh, and she wears glasses now, big round ones. She looks a bit like a college professor.
Danny: Ha! OK. Is she tall like you or shorter?
Ana: About the same. Oh, and don't be surprised if she looks a little tired. It's an overnight flight, and she never sleeps on planes.
Danny: Fine. And how will she know me?
Ana: I'll send her your photo. Just hold a sign with her name on it. Thank you so much, Danny. You're a lifesaver!
Danny: No worries. See you tomorrow night!
